h1. Architecture Overview

This document describes the technical architecture of the Personal Documentation System.

h2. System Components

{mermaid}
graph TB
    subgraph Frontend["Angular Frontend :4200"]
        AL[Doc List Component]
        AV[Doc Viewer Component]
        AE[Doc Editor Component]
        AS[Docs Service]
        CP[confluenceParser.js]
        ML[mermaidLoader.js]
    end

    subgraph Backend["Spring Boot Backend :8080"]
        DC[DocumentController]
        DS[DocumentService]
        FS[File System]
    end

    AL -- HTTP GET /api/docs --> DC
    AV -- HTTP GET /api/docs/:id --> DC
    AE -- HTTP POST /api/docs/:id --> DC
    DC --> DS
    DS --> FS
    AV --> CP
    CP --> ML
{/mermaid}

h2. Backend

The backend is a Spring Boot 3 application that exposes a REST API over the local filesystem.

||Component||Responsibility||
|{{PersonalDocsApplication}}|Entry point|
|{{DocumentController}}|REST endpoints (list / get / save / delete)|
|{{DocumentService}}|File I/O, title extraction, category resolution|
|{{Document}}|Full document model (includes content)|
|{{DocumentMeta}}|Lightweight list entry (no content)|

h3. API Reference

||Method||Path||Description||
|GET|/api/docs|List all documents (metadata only)|
|GET|/api/docs/\{id\}|Retrieve a document with full content|
|POST|/api/docs/\{id\}|Create or update a document|
|DELETE|/api/docs/\{id\}|Delete a document|

h3. Storage Layout

{noformat}
~/personal-docs/docs/
├── getting-started.wiki      → id: "getting-started"
├── architecture/
│   └── overview.wiki         → id: "architecture/overview"
└── team/
    └── on-boarding.wiki      → id: "team/on-boarding"
{noformat}

h2. Frontend

The Angular 17 frontend uses *Angular Material* for the shell layout and delegates rendering to the two JS modules ported from the *Vonfluence* wiki previewer.

h3. Rendering Pipeline

{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User
    participant AV as DocViewer
    participant CP as confluenceParser
    participant ML as mermaidLoader

    U->>AV: select document
    AV->>AV: fetch /api/docs/:id
    AV->>CP: parseConfluence(content)
    CP-->>AV: raw HTML
    AV->>AV: DOMPurify.sanitize
    AV->>AV: innerHTML = sanitisedHtml
    AV->>ML: renderMermaid(viewerEl)
    ML-->>AV: SVGs injected
    AV-->>U: page rendered
{/mermaid}

h2. Key Design Decisions

{tip}
*File-first storage* — documents are plain text files so you can edit them with any text editor, commit them to git, or sync them with any cloud drive.
{tip}

{note}
*No database* — the backend has zero external dependencies beyond the JDK and Maven. Just run and go.
{note}

{warning}
*No authentication* — this is a local-only personal tool. Do not expose port 8080 publicly without adding Spring Security.
{warning}
